policy: All screens share these roles. New JSX controls require a classified semantic role; existing controls migrate incrementally.

operatingRules.roleClassification: Information hierarchy and action importance are independent. Do not resize a primary action because it is inside a subsection.
operatingRules.stateColors: Neutral is default. Amber = needs action, green = success/wholesale when explicitly labeled, red = error/destructive, blue = selection/linked source; no decorative status colors.
operatingRules.layout: Align sibling inputs to the same label and value columns; button width adapts to label but heights/padding follow the role. Preserve money's right edge and VAT beside the amount.

pendingKakaoToolbar.location: inside the KakaoTalk pane at the top, above the native Windows window docking area
pendingKakaoToolbar.interaction: Three independent buttons. Never use a cycling/switch-to-next mode button. Active view indicated with aria-pressed.
pendingKakaoToolbar.visibility: Only show docked-mode controls while the native KakaoTalk session is connected.
pendingKakaoToolbar.constraint: The toolbar must remain within the Kakao pane and outside the native overlay region; do not cover KakaoTalk's chat input or list scrollbar.

pendingBrand.rule: Brand symbol and BANDO HUB logotype should have comparable visual height; test-workspace label is subordinate; remove unidentified trailing stripe without deleting any functional separator.

operatingRules.brightBusinessActions: Reception New Order, proxy shipping, dealer delivery, direct entry, capture range and KakaoTalk connect use action-emphasized (white background, dark text, blue hover). Retain 34px height and label-based width. Keycaps and unrelated buttons remain neutral.
operatingRules.workflowOneTouchHover: One-touch stage hover: 250ms entry and 250ms return. Same card component renders temporary expanded copy at the original anchor, with no coordinate-based portal or card reflow. TEMPORARY DISPLAY is BLUE: the temporary card border and currently displayed recipient row use the selection-blue token. COMMITTED SELECTION is ORANGE: original selected card and shipment rows retain orange styling; preview never receives the chosen class. Preview row mouse entry waits 100ms and row exit resets after 150ms. Moving across rows cancels timers and temporarily updates the shipment displayed in source/details via stageHover.shipmentId, without persisting selection, order data, or expanding the original card. Clicking the row selects it and expands the original card. Do not render a visible status label that truncates the recipient name. Stage action clicks are explicit.
operatingRules.linkedSourceHoverGrace: Linked source, recipient and product hover activates after 100ms, clears 150ms after pointer exit; crossing another key cancels pending timers. Keyboard focus and explicit selection are immediate. Hover must not commit shipment selection or persist business changes.
operatingRules.oneTouchControlEmphasis: While a valid one-touch workflow-button preview is active, use a single explicitly scoped data-one-touch-hover target whitelist. Only actual recipient name/address/mobile/phone/note inputs; product edit, quantity input and line-amount buttons; freight label and amount input, prepaid/collect select and only aria-pressed=true dispatch-origin button; compact VAT checkbox label; total amount label, total value and the numeric count-plus-건 value receive orange inner-box emphasis. Never outline or recolor the entire source/dealer/checks/review/items panel, freight row, message, footer, fixed 택배 label/separators or VAT summary. Linked source evidence stays blue and must take precedence; selected workflow shipment colors are independent. Emphasis uses box-shadow and background without padding/border changes, preserving layout. One-touch hover timing remains 250ms enter/return. STAGE 2 ('운임 적용') IS AN EXCEPTION: highlight only the product-name edit control, quantity input, applied freight input, prepaid/collect selector, selected dispatch-origin button, plus the recipient address input ONLY when the current settled Rust shipping preview status is auto or review. Do not emphasize name, phone, note, price, freight label, remote checkbox, VAT checkbox, invoice total or shipment count for stage 2. All other stages retain their current target whitelist. Also for stage 2, highlight the freight value of EVERY shipment in only the hovered order group (including the temporary in-place expanded preview), without changing recipient/product cells, other groups, or the group's grand-total value. Gate by the hovered group identity and stage 2; do not restrict to the selected shipment.
operatingRules.remoteFreightCheckbox: Rust locality data offers an initial 도서/산간 checkbox state for each recipient address. In the freight row position one checkbox immediately left of 공장에 운임 문의, using the normal neutral checkbox accent; put the blue nonblocking locality advisory for auto/review candidate areas in 확인할 내용 with a jump to the checkbox, not below the freight input. The checked state, not a pre-doubled amount, drives applied freight = underlying base x (checked ? 2 : 1). Manual checked or unchecked selection overrides the auto suggestion for that exact address and persists in the recipient record; address changes re-enable Rust detection. Rust business totals, VAT, shipping previews and delivery settlement must use the same factor; normal and transferred historical orders must not be retroactively doubled. Do not turn recorded remote actual delivery fees into active ordinary tariff combinations. The preview displays applied amount while storage retains base amount. A manually entered applied value must resolve to an integer base. Keep controls within the synchronized data-only fade.
operatingRules.dataOnlyFadeReadiness: Five synchronized content areas: raw source, staff checks, copyable auto-message, recipient details, and items/freight. HubWorkspace owns exactly one sharedFadePhase for the current order/shipment view key. The source must have a current Rust projection, checks and financial projections must report readiness, and the message must match current fingerprint/order/group/links or be explicitly not applicable. No area fades in early; all payloads receive ready in one render and transition opacity 260ms together. Retain already revealed content through same-view edits; ignore stale completion reports for previous view keys. Actual projection failures are settled errors rather than infinite wait. All headings, borders, separators, genuinely static empty-input instructions, scroll surfaces and fixed buttons stay visible. Computed outcome text such as '필수 확인 사항 없음' is not a static placeholder and must stay inside the shared fade payload. The recipient-review element must not have a competing detail-in or opacity animation, since animation opacity can override pending visibility. Pending content is inert, only replaceable payloads fade. Hover delays, business selection, and SQLite are unchanged.
operatingRules.notificationCenterPolicy: The header and modal are only for explicitly critical/action-blocking operating problems, never routine success/info or factory reply scans. No native factory-reply-review count in the header. Do not render factoryReplies as permanent history in the notification modal. Existing legacy notices without critical priority stay hidden and may be cleared. A critical alert can be marked read, deleted individually, or cleared with all alerts in the isolated SQLite hub_notifications table. Factory reply import processing, conflict corrections and business audit history stay in the Factory Queue section. Factory file arrival notifications remain disabled until the factory-side program exists.

text-primary.usage: data, titles, editable values and action labels

text-secondary.usage: field labels, secondary actions and supporting descriptions

text-muted.usage: timestamps and low-priority metadata; never sole carrier of required business information

text-danger.usage: error messages and destructive action labels, independent of font hierarchy

text-warning.usage: manual verification/attention; never normal navigation highlight

text-selected.usage: linked source evidence/selection in content, not all active tabs

surface-nested.usage: nested information groups inside a section

surface-input.usage: editable inputs, search and choice controls

surface-interactive-hover.usage: mouse hover on any neutral interactive surface

border-emphasis.usage: major group or table header boundary

border-selected.usage: content selection; not a substitute for focus

surface-emphasized-action.usage: high-visibility reception and KakaoTalk connect actions only; excludes shortcut keycaps and folder path controls

surface-emphasized-action-hover.usage: hover state for explicitly promoted actions, distinct from selected content and keyboard focus

page-frame.purpose: whole screen content; not itself a card

primary-section.purpose: standalone business section, only one surrounding perimeter

nested-section.purpose: subsection visually inside an existing major section; do not duplicate outer heavy borders

field-group.purpose: label + inputs in the same form; grid and aligned baselines, no unnecessary box

information-block.purpose: neutral information to be read together

summary-strip.purpose: compact shipment count, VAT and amounts on one aligned row

toolbar-group.purpose: search/filter and context actions in one row

warning-block.purpose: confirmation needed; show label and reason, not color alone

error-block.purpose: actionable error or operation failure; full readable message

divider-soft.purpose: separate rows within same group, never surround each row

divider-strong.purpose: one boundary between independently meaningful sections

structureGuidance.ownership: Container border belongs to the outer section only; child groups do not each add a second enclosing outline.
structureGuidance.choose: Use bordered sections for independent business units, dividers for siblings in one unit, and neutral information blocks for logically inseparable fields.
structureGuidance.density: Same-role sections must have identical padding and border thickness. Use smaller nested grouping, not unrelated margins, for compact layouts.
structureGuidance.spacing: Use the shared 4/8/12/16/24px rhythm; balance top and bottom padding and align information block headings to the same left edge.
structureGuidance.selection: Highlight selection without changing geometry; focus and selected states are visually distinct and cannot change element size.
structureGuidance.responsive: At reduced width, wrap complete information groups or scroll tables within their area; never allow amount/phone values or buttons to clip.
structureGuidance.edgeCases: Do not add borders to each field or row inside an already bordered group; avoid fake dividers with empty pseudo-elements.
structureGuidance.rollout: Specification only; existing cross-screen CSS migration is postponed until the user explicitly resumes it.
